jobs.objective: Publish the RFC 0165 v5 holder SPEC as a surgical continuation of v4, not a rewrite. Read SEED.md, context/v4_HOLDER.md, both v4 falsifier challenges, context/v4_LEDGER_cycle_1.md, the v3 context, RFC 0165, and RFC 0169 first. Preserve the v4-cleared spine: distinct-UID Claude lanes use an access-token-only projection, same-user Claude OAuth self-driving lanes fail closed, lane-file samples are downgrade-only, refresh authority stays outside the lane, receipts and events stay redacted, and RFC 0169 remains the separate provider-agnostic spine. Discharge the three v4 carry-forward constraints. C1: recovery positive freshness must be bound to the stalled job or supervisor launch credential generation, not a latest singleton provider_auth_dependencies row for the lane user. A newer same-lane-user projection may prove a fresh relaunch is possible, but must not prove an older stalled session fresh. Specify the launch-bound receipt fields and add TestRecoveryClassifiesExpiredLaunchGenerationDespiteNewerProjection plus a per-session decay test. C3: provider_credential_projection=off must not remain a Claude OAuth bypass that can leave a lane-readable whole credential in HOME or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Prefer a typed fail-closed launch precondition for Claude OAuth when projection is disabled; otherwise require the same all-surfaces refresh_token_absent scan before launch. Add TestProjectionOffCannotLaunchWithRefreshTokenCredentialSurface and TestProjectionOffStillValidatesClaudeConfigDir. C2 ordering: the same-user precondition must run before the generic provider-auth gate so gate modes auto, off, and required all return provider_credential_same_user_unsupported before side effects. Add TestSameUserClaudeLaneRefusedBeforeSideEffects across those modes. State every claim as a falsifiable assertion plus test. Keep local-first and never expose raw OAuth material, provider output, bearer tokens, local secret paths, or private diagnostics in durable artifacts.
jobs.title: Hold leading proposal

jobs.objective: Read the v5 holder SPEC, SEED.md, context/v4_LEDGER_cycle_1.md, context/v4_FALSIFIER_1.md, and the v3 context. Your lens is C1 launch-generation binding plus the C2 ordering caveat. Attack the overlapping-session race from the v4 ledger: older session A launched with generation G1, newer same-lane-user session B writes fresh generation G2 into the latest dependency row, then A stalls. Does v5 recovery classify A against A's own launch-bound receipt and expiry, or can G2 still make A look fresh and burn generic recovery budget? Verify the proposed state is daemon-owned and session, supervisor, or job bound; a newer row may only justify a fresh relaunch. Check the named test covers expired G1 despite fresh G2, and that near-expiry or reseed debt is per running generation. Then check C2 ordering: same-user Claude OAuth lanes must refuse before any provider-auth gate and before side effects, with provider_credential_same_user_unsupported in auto, off, and required modes. Gate does not clear if freshness remains keyed only to the latest lane-user row, generic recovery can still consume a provider-auth stall, or same-user refusal can still surface as a generic lane_provider_auth_failed error.
jobs.title: Falsifier 1

jobs.objective: Read the v5 holder SPEC, SEED.md, context/v4_LEDGER_cycle_1.md, context/v4_FALSIFIER_2.md, and the v3 context. Your lens is C3 projection-disabled custody plus carry-forward regression. Reconstruct the v4 counterexample: distinct lane OS user, provider_credential_projection=off, a lane-readable whole Claude credential in HOME or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and then the Claude process starts without projection, scrub, or all-surfaces scan. Does v5 fail closed before launch for Claude OAuth when projection is disabled, or otherwise prove refresh_token_absent across every lane-readable credential surface named by the launch environment before process start? The tests must cover both HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR whole-credential files, with a refreshToken present, and assert a typed precondition refusal before side effects. Then verify no carry-forward regressed: same-user remains unsupported fail-closed, normal distinct-UID B1 or B2 projection remains access-token-only, lane samples stay downgrade-only, receipts do not persist access tokens, redaction holds, and RFC 0096 control-plane separation remains intact. Gate does not clear if projection-disabled Claude OAuth can still launch with any unscanned whole credential surface, or if the closure breaks the accepted projection path.
jobs.title: Falsifier 2

jobs.objective: Read only the RFC 0165 v5 dialogue trajectory: holder HOLDER.md and the two FALSIFIER.md challenges, with SEED.md and the v4 ledger as binding context. Publish a collaboration ledger verdict: accept, accept_with_findings, needs_revision, or reject. A clearing verdict requires all of the following. C1 is discharged: recovery positive freshness is evaluated against the stalled job or supervisor's launch-bound provider credential generation, not the latest lane-user dependency row; newer projections cannot make older stalled sessions fresh; provider-auth expiry does not burn generic recovery budget; named tests cover expired G1 despite fresh G2 and per-session decay. C3 is discharged: provider_credential_projection=off is not a Claude OAuth bypass; either it fails closed before launch with a typed precondition, or it proves refresh_token_absent across HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, resolver destination, credential-bearing env entries, helper or broker settings, and inherited credential paths before launch; named tests cover projection-off HOME and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR whole credentials. C2 ordering is discharged: same-user Claude OAuth refusal precedes the generic provider-auth gate and side effects in auto, off, and required modes. Carry-forwards remain intact: same-user unsupported fail-closed, normal distinct-UID access-token-only projection, path and ownership rules, downgrade-only lane samples, F1 decay, durable receipts with no token persistence, redaction, RFC 0096 separation, and refresh_token_absent. Return needs_revision if any material challenge stands, any accepted carry-forward regressed, or the tests are not falsifiable.
jobs.title: Adjudicate dialogue substance

jobs.objective: Publish the cleared, revised falsifiable implementation SPEC for RFC 0165 only after the adjudicator ledger records accept or accept_with_findings. Consolidate the whole Claude assurance design, not just deltas: distinct-UID access-token-only projection; same-user Claude OAuth fail-closed; projection-disabled Claude OAuth fail-closed or all-surfaces prelaunch scan; launch-generation-bound recovery freshness; downgrade-only lane samples; F1 runtime-expiry circuit breaker and decay; durable receipts with no access-token persistence; redaction; RFC 0096 separation; and the seam to RFC 0169. State each claim as a falsifiable assertion and name the tests: expired launch generation despite newer projection, per-session decay, projection-off HOME whole credential refusal, projection-off CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR whole credential refusal, same-user refusal before side effects across gate modes, normal distinct-UID projection positive control, and redaction or refresh_token_absent controls. Reference the clearing ledger path. This consolidated SPEC is the single source a later rfc-0165-build code_change workflow implements.
